about: Statistics of the Style Guide Agent (Assignment 6), in the registry's entry schema. They enter content/params/tuning.parameters.json with the next registry version; the P7.13 suite gates the registry at edit94 (test_p713.js, check 'the story's values are registry IDs'), so they wait here (decision 543).

entries.label: Bark length
entries.description: Characters in one bark bubble: three lines of the 6-art-px field face (ui.typeFieldLabel).
entries.source: GDD Edit 39 §6.6; FARSIGHT Style Guide, Field text

entries.label: Stock endings per batch
entries.description: Lines in one batch that may end on a stock word (Noted, Logged, Recorded, Filed), or close on the same short tag (Kind regards).

entries.label: Tale length
entries.description: Characters in one tile tale: four lines on the tile card. The longest shipped tale (Waterfront B2).
entries.source: GDD Edit 92 Measured; Edit 93 Tales rewritten

entries.label: Tale sentence length
entries.description: Words in one sentence of a tale. Shipped tales: median 8, longest 19.

entries.label: Brief label length
entries.description: Characters in a brief's caps label. Shipped: 7–19 (STRUCK, NOT DASHING).

entries.label: Act line length
entries.description: Sentences in a district's act line (intro). Shipped: 2, 3, 2.

entries.label: Blocking deduction
entries.description: Points off for one blocking violation: canon, truth or a hard limit.

entries.label: Major deduction
entries.description: Points off for one major violation: a voice or format break a player would notice.

entries.label: Minor deduction
entries.description: Points off for one minor violation: drift, casing, a stock ending too many.

entries.label: Target score
entries.description: The loop stops when a piece scores this.

entries.label: Refine rounds
entries.description: Refiner passes before the loop stops without the target.

entries.label: Confirmations
entries.description: Fresh evaluator calls that must also give the target score before a piece is accepted. A dissent goes back to the refiner as its REASON.
entries.source: Run 20261029-135110-d78-monument: the batch pass found three truth slips that 10/10 tile passes had missed

entries.label: Shipped floor
entries.description: Calibration: a shipped line or tale with no lint finding scores at least this.
